newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria finds bomb before Romanian President visit.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria finds bomb before Romanian President visit.

text.p: Bulgarian police found explosives hidden on the road to Sofia airport two hours before the arrival of Romanian President Emil Constantinescu last week, the Interior Ministry said on Monday.

Interior Minister Bogomil Bonev said the explosive was very powerful but he could not say whether it had been intended for the car carrying Constantinescu and his Bulgarian counterpart Petar Stoyanov. He said police were investigating the find.

"Some 700 grammes of TNT explosive were found on April 30 at around 1500 hours (1200 GMT) wrapped in a plastic bag, which would make a powerful hand grenade," Interior Ministry spokesman Chavdar Krumov told Reuters.
Local newspapers said the explosive had been planted in an electrical junction box at a crossroads before the airport where cars generally slow down.

Among the theories put forward by the newspapers was that an attack on Constantinescu could have been planned by Turkish Kurds, as they said Romania had taken strict measures against the Kurdistan Workers' Party.
Bombs have often been used by Bulgaria's shady business groups to settle internal quarrels.
